messages:
Maria_CS: Quick sync — Spark Bridge cohort onboarding checklist and micro-feedback plan. We have 6 enrollments left to validate SSO and dataset access before next Wed. Can folks confirm owners? @aj_sales @leo_pm

aj_sales: I can own enrollments 1-3, reaching out to legal for AAD provisioning today.

leo_pm: I'll cover 4-6 and do the enablement deck update (added slide on data retention + KMS).

sophia_csm: Heads up — Tidebank asked that we surface product metrics during preview. They want a 30m call to see live usage. @Maria_CS can you do a quick demo?

Maria_CS: Yes. I'll schedule a 30m demo + Q&A. Proposed times: Tue 10:00am or Wed 2:00pm PST. Book here: <https://cal.com/redwood/spark-demo|Schedule>.

devbot: Note — onboarding playbook updated. After SSO completes run: `./scripts/grant-access --cohort spark --users user_list.csv`.

aj_sales: Also flag — one seat is blocked by IP allowlist. @eng-infra can we get a temporary rule?

leo_pm: Eng infra said they can open 1 IP for 48h if we provide CIDR. Tidebank gave `35.167.90.12/32`.

sophia_csm: Micro-feedback plan: send a 3-question survey 24h after first session (quick thumbs + 1 open), then NPS at 2 weeks. I'll draft the short survey and post here.

Maria_CS: Added risk register items to the board: `low-usage`, `data-mismatch`, `SSO-lag`. Also linking the project board: https://redwood.internal/boards/spark-bridge-onboard

aj_sales: I'll draft a 3-bullet outreach script for low-usage nudges before trial end — short, value-focused.

leo_pm: Ops ask — can we create an automated metric alert for token usage at 30% of projected? Want to catch low-usage early.

ops_bot: Alert rule created: `cohort.spark.token_usage < 0.3 * projected` -> notify #customer-success and #eng-oncall.

Maria_CS: Action items recap: 1) @aj_sales — enrollments 1-3 + IP follow-up; 2) @leo_pm — enrollments 4-6 + deck update; 3) @sophia_csm — survey draft + send cadence; 4) @Maria_CS — schedule demo + update project board. Please reply 'done' when complete. :white_check_mark:

aj_sales: done (AAD request sent, IP ticket filed)

leo_pm: done (slides updated, 4-6 invited)

sophia_csm: draft posted, will send survey after first session

Maria_CS: thanks team — logging this thread to the cohort notes and moving to weekly check-in. :sparkles:
